title: Official Metadata Addon Provider Extension Decentralization
problem: Provider extension still leaks provider-specific config, external ID alias, and rendered-page support facts through central modules.

evidence.summary: Workstream opened from user-approved follow-on provider extension refactor Goal.
ProviderConfig now uses typed provider config variants and provider-local config structs live in provider modules while public env and manifest compatibility is preserved.
Provider catalog entries now own top-level external ID alias and numeric validation descriptors consumed by MetadataScrapeRuntime query parsing.
Browser_worker and Douban now share explicit RenderedPageSupportConfig while preserving existing browser-worker env vars and metadata provider semantics.
Full nako-metadata-scraper package validation passed and README docs now mention explicit external IDs plus provider-owned top-level aliases.
Closeout review found no blocking findings; final package, format, JSON, and diff hygiene gates passed with no follow-ons split.

continue_policy.notes: Provider config decentralization, provider-owned external ID aliases, rendered-page support semantics, cleanup, integration, and closeout are complete. No follow-on was split; live smoke and release work remain intentionally out of scope.
